trace.event: The identity service verifies the customer before protected order lookup.
The purchase service matches both owned line items; the spare cable was purchased separately.
System One records two AND tasks: exchange the headphones and return the separately purchased spare cable.
The customer chooses the headphone exchange first; the cable return stays pending.
The exchange service checks its own policy and stock, then quotes the exchange terms.
The customer confirms the quoted exchange terms; service authorization is still pending.
The service issues an exchange ID after rechecking authority, policy, stock, and accepted terms; the cable return remains pending.
Agent Graph resumes the cable return. Its policy, confirmation, and authorization are unfinished.
